hassio_confirm.title: KNX Monitor add-on found
hassio_confirm.description: Set up the KNX Monitor add-on as a device? It then provides sensors, the recording switch, device triggers, services, diagnostics and repairs. The add-on stops announcing the same entities over MQTT while the integration is set up.

error.cannot_connect: The KNX Monitor add-on does not answer. Is it running?

abort.already_configured: KNX Monitor is already set up.
abort.addon_required: KNX Monitor is set up through its add-on: install and start the KNX Monitor add-on, then Home Assistant offers the integration by itself.
abort.single_instance_allowed: KNX Monitor is already set up.
abort.not_knx_monitor_addon: Another add-on announced itself as KNX Monitor and was ignored. Only the KNX Monitor add-on can set up this integration.

not_loaded.message: KNX Monitor is not set up or the add-on is not running.

export_too_large.message: The export was aborted because it is larger than {limit} MB. Export fewer days instead of everything.

export_running.message: An export of the KNX Monitor history is already running. Wait until it has finished.

bus_disconnected.title: KNX bus not connected
bus_disconnected.description: The KNX Monitor add-on has had no bus connection since {since}, so nothing is being recorded. Check the gateway or the connection in the add-on (KNX Monitor in the sidebar).

low_space.title: KNX Monitor: recording paused, disk full
low_space.description: The disk is almost full. The add-on already removed the oldest days and has paused the recording. Free up space or shorten the retention in KNX Monitor; the recording continues by itself.

create_report.name: Create report
create_report.description: Creates the installation report of the KNX Monitor add-on now and returns it.

export_history.name: Export history
export_history.description: Saves the history of the KNX Monitor add-on as ETS group monitor file in the folder knx_monitor of the configuration. SpectrumKNX and the ETS read it.

days.name: Days
days.description: Today and the days before it, at most 31.

everything.name: Everything
everything.description: The whole history as zip with one file per day, instead of the days above.
